raw_text: Banking sector sources confirm: NPCI UPI gateway under sustained DDoS attack since 1 AM IST. Traffic volume unprecedented at 3.2 Tbps. Multiple CDN layers overwhelmed. SBI, HDFC, ICICI payment processing severely impacted. RBI has convened emergency meeting. Eastern European botnet identified as source. Recovery timeline uncertain.
clean_text: Banking sources confirm sustained DDoS on NPCI UPI gateway since 1 AM at 3.2 Tbps. Multiple CDN layers overwhelmed. RBI convened emergency meeting. Eastern European botnet identified.
